# Dotfile backup

Keeps a copy of the shell and editor configuration so a fresh machine can be
brought up in one step.

Run `scripts/backup.sh` to produce the archive.

Nothing in this markdown is hostile — no injected instructions, no suspicious
host, nothing a judge reading the prose would object to. That is the point of
the fixture: the payload is in the helper.
